<!-- AUTOGENERATED by eng/DocsGen. Do not edit; run `dotnet run --project eng/DocsGen`. -->

These values apply when no configuration file, environment variable, or argument sets them.

| Setting | Default |
|---|---|
| `framework` | `net9.0` |
| `slnx` | `false` |

`output` has no built-in default. Each command falls back to the current working directory, so `--output` may be omitted.
